svg.title: Protein
svg.desc: Folded protein ribbon showing alpha helices, beta sheet, connecting loops, and a small ligand-binding pocket. Biological basis: Protein tertiary structure packs secondary-structure elements into a three-dimensional fold whose surface pockets support molecular recognition.
